title: Viola Mod
description: Viola Decorative is a more-decorative mod for creating cities and buildings in the style of the 18th and 19th centuries.
body:
**A small mod that adds mostly decorative blocks (for now).**

Designed primarily for builders and fans of pleasant ambient aesthetics. It includes stone and wooden blocks that are more or less suitable for construction, primarily in the 18th–19th-century style. For the most part, it was created for my own use, but perhaps someone else might also find it interesting to experiment with. It also adds some variations of vanilla blocks that are missing from the game.
